medications.name: Ibuprofen
medications.common_dosage: 200mg - 400mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed with food
warnings: Take with food or milk to protect stomach lining
Avoid if you have active stomach ulcers, severe kidney disease, or bleeding disorders
Do not combine with other NSAIDs (aspirin, naproxen)

medications.name: Acetaminophen
medications.common_dosage: 325mg - 650mg every 4 to 6 hours or 1000mg every 6 hours
warnings: Do not exceed maximum daily limit — severe liver injury risk
Check combination cold/flu medicines to avoid double dosing

medications.name: Aspirin
medications.common_dosage: 81mg daily (cardiac prophylaxis) or 325mg - 650mg every 4 hours for pain
warnings: Do not give to children or teenagers recovering from chickenpox or flu (Reye's syndrome risk)

medications.name: Lisinopril
warnings: Monitor potassium levels — avoid high potassium supplements

medications.name: Amlodipine
warnings: May cause low blood pressure when standing up quickly

medications.name: Metformin
warnings: Take with meals to minimize GI distress
Risk of lactic acidosis — report severe fatigue or muscle pain immediately

medications.name: Sertraline
medications.common_dosage: 50mg - 100mg once daily in morning or evening
warnings: Do not stop abruptly — taper off with doctor supervision
Watch for increased suicidal thoughts when starting

medications.name: Alprazolam
warnings: High risk of dependence and tolerance
Never combine with alcohol or opioids — severe respiratory depression risk

medications.name: Albuterol
medications.common_dosage: 1 - 2 puffs every 4 to 6 hours as needed for shortness of breath
warnings: Seek emergency help if inhaler does not relieve breathing difficulty

medications.name: Omeprazole
warnings: Long-term use may lower vitamin B12 and magnesium levels
